name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-05-25, at wavelengths from 1.21 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
